name: smwgraphics-kirby-s-adventure-starman
title: Kirby's Adventure - Starman
description: This graphic replaces the Ninji with the Starman from the Kirby series. Compared to the original sprite, I've added some colors to make it fit better with SMW and to look more accurate to its artwork. I would recommend using this guy with an edited Ninji disassembly set to only jump very high, but it's up to you how you these graphics. Enjoy!
